status: UNCONSTRAINED DESIGN SEARCH v0.3 (canon set aside, physics kept). Radiator architecture options informed by published NASA work. Not canon, not engineering.

juhasz_cc_heatpipe.what: carbon-carbon heat-pipe radiator, Nb-1Zr liner, potassium; 1.45 kg/m2; segmented heat pipes tolerate micrometeoroids

ohp_alkali_nep.what: alkali-metal oscillating heat pipe radiator, 750-1000 K; 7.65 kg/m2 prototype, <4 kg/m2 predicted, <6 target, <3 industry wish

marvl_nep.what: robot-assembled modular radiators; tri/quad-wing arrays lose to wing-to-wing view factors; planar bi-wing 20-40% lighter; 4.5 kg/m2 threshold, 3 kg/m2 goal

liquid_belt_droplet.what: liquid belt radiator 0.6-1.3 kg/m2 (20-50% of heat pipe systems); liquid metals emit only ~0.1-0.2; droplet inventory loss risk

discovery_ii.what: NASA spherical-torus fusion ship: 7,895 MW fusion, 4,830 MW jet, ~1,1-1,2 GW to radiators, helium coolant 997-1,700 K, C-C heat-pipe radiators, 240 m long

direct_fusion_drive.what: recycles bremsstrahlung and synchrotron heat through the RF heating system; tungsten at ~2000 K, radiators at 625 K

sma_morphing.what: shape-memory morphing radiator; crewed missions need ~12:1 turndown, current tech ~3:1

ROOT_QUAD.label: Four wings on the aft root band
ROOT_QUAD.plant_fins: fore fins for the fore half

ROOT_BIWING.label: Two flat wings on the aft root band
ROOT_BIWING.plant_fins: fore fins for the fore half
ROOT_BIWING.note: MARVL/Discovery II style co-planar wings; drop tanks move to the lower diagonals

STRAKE_QUAD.label: Four hull strakes on the diagonals
STRAKE_QUAD.note: long radiators along the hull; root band shrinks to 2 m of heat exchangers

STRAKE_BIWING.label: Two hull strakes on the sides
STRAKE_BIWING.note: co-planar strakes; drop tanks on the lower diagonals

strake_recess_m_by_layout.note: free depth between tanks and hull skin under each strake root; authored from the layouts

ACCORDION.label: Accordion heat-pipe pleats
ACCORDION.basis: 3 kg/m2 C-C or OHP heat-pipe panel (Juhasz, OHP, MARVL range) plus 2 kg/m2 hinges and flexible joints

ROLLOUT.label: Roll-out pumped-loop membrane
ROLLOUT.basis: flexible panel cannot use rigid heat pipes; pumped liquid-metal microchannels assumed

RIGID.label: Hinged rigid heat-pipe panel
RIGID.basis: the repo placeholder; C-C heat-pipe panel with structure

view_factor.method: 2D Monte Carlo from each wing face: fraction of emission reaching space, hull, or other wings
view_factor.note: hull and wings treated as absorbers (net loss); finite chord along x ignored

score.note: authored weights for the single pick; also reported: Pareto set and best per placement/temperature

hull_coating.note: low-absorptivity coating on the hull under every radiator; half of what it reflects is assumed to escape to space (authored)

torch_rating_required_g.note: headline pick requires main radiators usable in HARD torch burns (5 g); roll-out designs are still reported
